verdict: P27 is implementation-complete and integration-ready. The P21 exact-candidate staged runtime is now wrapped after its runtime-command builder so the staged process can feed only exact W3 actor-slot/generation identity into the maintained exact-candidate P12->P10 canonical coordinator and expose the resulting real wof-alpha-canonical-runtime-coordinator-v1 status through the existing staged publisher. Current W3 renderer-source qualification remains unproven, so P10 truthfully emits coordinate-free SUPPRESSED/RENDERER_SOURCE_UNPROVEN records rather than upgrading W3/V3 measurement coordinates into canonical coordinates.

canonicalFeedExposure.inputBoundary: Only W3 exact runtime actor slot/name plus generation identity is translated into the P12 frame identity contract. W3 x/y/z, candidate regions, screenshots, world projection, structural-row positions and guessed coordinates are not copied.
canonicalFeedExposure.currentAnchorPolicy: SUPPRESSED/RENDERER_SOURCE_UNPROVEN and coordinate-free until a separately legitimate renderer-source proof exists
canonicalFeedExposure.replayPolicy: duplicate sampleAt plus identical identity signature is not accepted as a new canonical cycle; conflicting replay, stale/out-of-order sample, renderer mismatch and generation regression fail closed
canonicalFeedExposure.replacementPolicy: authority/replacement rebind revokes and clears the previous coordinator feed before activating the new exact identity
canonicalFeedExposure.publisherSurface: existing P21 staged MeasurementPublisher payload canonicalCoordinator plus alpha_status.canonicalOverlay; renderAuthorityV3 remains a separate non-canonical diagnostic surface

productProof.detail: P27 proves the staged publisher seam now exposes a genuine maintained P10 coordinator status and preserves fail-closed identity/suppression boundaries. It does not prove real WOF visibility, W3 renderer-source qualification, P22/P24 dynamic/stability coverage, or P25 final composite acceptance.
